description:
Renders the scene locally (headless Chrome, the real AVIZ engine, a synthetic beat — no audio) so you can see it.
png: one frame, returned as an image. mp4: a short clip saved to a file, plus a 2×2 sheet of frames as an image. Files carry no metadata.
Previews are saved only as new files, in the system temp folder or (save_to) in your home folder; nothing is ever overwritten.
drop:true fires the music drop right before the frame (png) or in the middle of the clip (mp4) — use it to check drop reactions.
Needs Google Chrome or Chromium (set AVIZ_CHROME to its path if it is elsewhere); mp4 also needs ffmpeg (AVIZ_FFMPEG).
Example: {"url":"https://app.aviz.studio/#scene=…","drop":true} · {"url":"…","format":"mp4","seconds":6}

at.description: png: seconds of music before the frame. Default 4.

bpm.description: Tempo of the synthetic beat. Default 128.

drop.description: Fire the drop (see above). Default false.

save_to.description: Where to save the png/mp4: a NEW file in an existing folder inside your home folder (not ~/Library or a hidden folder) or in the system temp folder, e.g. ~/Desktop/preview.png. Never overwrites a file and never creates folders. Default: a new file in the system temp folder.

scene.description: Or a scene object as for build_scene.

auto_bind.description: Default true: every new node gets the music bindings the editor would give it (see default_binds in list_effects); your binds are applied on top. false: only your binds.

from_port.description: Default "out" (image) or the modulator output ("value", or "bass"/"beat"/… on the "audio" node).

to_port.description: Default: the first free image input of the target ("in" for filters and output, "a" then "b" for blend, "under" for a generator). "p:<paramId>" drives a number param from a modulator.

name.description: Scene title shown in the app (up to 120 characters).

auto_bind.description: Per-node override of the scene auto_bind.

binds.description: Music bindings for number params: paramId → source ("bass") or { "source": "drop", "amount": 0.6 } (amount -1..1, share of the param range added at full signal) or null to remove a default binding. Sources: bass, mid, high, level, beat, drop, energy, pace, phase, bar, key, mood, band1–band8; "link" = strength of a modulator linked to "p:<paramId>".

id.description: Your name for the node, used in links (1–40 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -). Defaults to the type.

inner_out.description: Containers only: [x, y] of the container output inside it.

params.description: paramId → value. Omitted params keep their defaults. number: within min..max; bool; colour "#rrggbb"; gradient ["#rrggbb", …]; text; choice: "value", ["v1","v2"] to switch between, or { "values": [...], "order": "sequence|random|pingpong", "trigger": "beat|beats|drop|time|dropOrTime", "every": N }.

parent.description: Optional: id of a container node (e.g. "stack") this node sits inside. A stack also takes layers from the main map: link any effect straight into its inputs s1…s8 (or leave to_port out to take the next free one), no parent needed.

y.description: Position on the node map; omit both for automatic layout.

url.description: A link from build_scene or get_template (or just its code).

name: preview
title: Preview an AVIZ scene
